message.content: The *Help!* album (1965) included "Another Girl," which had not appeared on any earlier Beatles album — unlike "All I've Got to Do" (which first appeared on *With the Beatles*, 1963) — so it's a track that debuted on this album.
message.reasoning_content: Help! album: With a Little Help, Another Girl included; All I've Got to Do was earlier (With the Beatles). Which first appeared on Help!? Both "With a Little Help from My Friends" and "Another Girl" — "include before any other album" — "Another Girl" is exclusive to Help!. Pick Another Girl.
